g.title: TF_ASSISTANT_RTPARAMS
g.text: Assistant intent runtime params entity - The entity that manage runtime parameters of each intent.
The code name of the parameter to resolve.
The name of the field that is the identifier of the entity
The name of the field that is the label of the entity
The name of the field that is the description of the entity
The name of the field that contains the entity avatar.
The list of the search fields
The criteria of the search to execute on entity
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
